description: crl.rs: CrlChecker::new stores raw DER bytes and re-parses on every check_revocation call. For a chain of N certs, this is O(N) CRL parses. The parsed CertificateList should be stored in the struct instead of the raw bytes. The current design is a performance surprise for users validating many certs against the same CRL.
title: CrlChecker should cache parsed CRL to avoid O(N) re-parsing
